description: This file defines a set of data classes and a singleton object for managing tool display configurations and summaries within an Android application. It includes serialization, configuration loading from assets, and utilities for resolving and representing tool display information.

classes.name: ToolDisplayActionSpec
classes.description: Represents the configuration for a specific action in the tool display.

classes.name: ToolDisplaySpec
classes.description: Defines the visual and descriptive specs for a tool, including optional emoji, title, label, detail keys, and actions.

classes.name: ToolDisplayConfig
classes.description: Encapsulates the overall configuration for tool displays, including version, fallback spec, and a map of tools.

classes.name: ToolDisplaySummary
classes.description: A data class for summarizing tool display info, with computed properties for detailed and summary lines.

classes.name: ToolDisplayRegistry
classes.description: Singleton object managing loading, caching, and resolving tool display specifications.

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Resolves and returns a ToolDisplaySummary based on context, tool name, arguments, and optional metadata.

methods.name: loadConfig
methods.description: Loads the tool display configuration from assets, with caching and error handling.

methods.name: titleFromName
methods.description: Generates a human-readable title from a tool name.

methods.name: normalizeVerb
methods.description: Normalizes verb strings by replacing underscores and trimming.

methods.name: readDetail
methods.description: Constructs a detail string for 'read' actions from arguments.

methods.name: pathDetail
methods.description: Extracts a path detail string from arguments.

methods.name: firstValue
methods.description: Finds the first non-blank value from a list of keys in the provided JSON arguments.

methods.name: valueForPath
methods.description: Retrieves a nested value from JSON arguments based on a dot-separated path.

methods.name: renderValue
methods.description: Converts a JsonElement to a readable string, handling primitives, arrays, and trimming.

methods.name: shortenHomeInString
methods.description: Replaces home directory paths with '~' in a string.

methods.name: asStringOrNull
methods.description: Converts a JsonElement to a nullable string if it is a primitive string.

methods.name: asNumberOrNull
methods.description: Converts a JsonElement to a nullable Double if it is a numeric primitive.
